title: Reset each transform mode on its own, with a dot on a changed mode
goal: Let a person undo one kind of change without losing the others, as the user approved on 2026-11-01: right-clicking a mode on the selection chip offers Reset Size, Reset Skew & distort, Reset 3D and Reset All (a mode with nothing to reset greyed), the same rows sit under Layer > Transform, and a mode that has been changed shows a small blue dot on its chip button.
notes: Slice (4) of the-reworked-selection-ships-cleaner-grips-a-tag. The double-click on the knob already turns back to 0 degrees (CanvasSelectionGrips.selectionGripMouseDown). A menu command needs to reach the canvas's transformMode (it lives on CanvasNSView, reset to Size when the pick changes). Existing Layer > Reset 3D Rotation (EditorCommands, next-turn-in-depth) should fold into Reset 3D. Prototype: openReset / resetStage / changed() in selection-transform.html.
acceptance: Right-click on a chip button opens Reset Size, Reset Skew & distort, Reset 3D and Reset All, unchanged modes greyed; each is one undo step
Layer > Transform holds Turn in 3D (enters 3D mode), Skew, Distort, Keystone and the four resets, each with its shortcut where one exists
A changed mode shows a small blue dot on its chip button (white on the picked one); Reset Size returns the picture's own size and no turn about the same middle
A walk at Next defaults right-clicks the chip by the pointer and resets each mode
